logline: Moved by Gajendra's prayer, Hari arrives swiftly on Garuḍa. Seeing the Lord, Gajendra raises a lotus; Nārāyaṇa lifts both struggling creatures from the lake, ends the crocodile's animal life with His disc and saves Gajendra.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam Canto 8 Chapter 3, original Telugu/Hindi/English devotional retelling; copyrighted published English translation not reproduced
source.verification_notes: SB 8.3.30: Gajendra appeals to Supreme rather than specific devas; Hari responds. 8.3.31: He reaches distressed Gajendra quickly mounted on Garuda with disc and other divine attributes, surrounded by praising devas. 8.3.32: only AFTER seeing Lord approaching on Garuda, Gajendra raises a lotus with trunk and offers a respectful address. 8.3.33: Hari alights, lifts Gajendra together WITH the crocodile from the lake, and severs the crocodile's mouth with His disc; the animal life ends and the elephant is saved. We use a non-graphic cutaway, not a changed outcome. Huhu's former Gandharva identity and Gajendra's sārūpya appear in 8.4 and later episodes. The six visual scenes extend just four verses through deliberate unmeasured art/camera holds, not fabricated incidents. S01: SB 8.3.30, 8.3.31 with canon-to-shot audiovisual continuity; original staging disclosed on relevant lines. S02: SB 8.3.31 with canon-to-shot audiovisual continuity; original staging disclosed on relevant lines. S03: SB 8.3.32 with canon-to-shot audiovisual continuity; original staging disclosed on relevant lines. S04: SB8.3.33 original safe visual editing is disclosed; the elephant+crocodile lift and the crocodile mouth-disc outcome remain accurate.

core_preserved: Gajendra's prayer is to the Supreme Lord, and Hari responds rather than a summoned ordinary deva (SB 8.3.30).
Hari rapidly arrives ON GARUDA with his Sudarshana and divine emblems as heavenly beings offer praise (SB 8.3.31).
Gajendra raises the lotus in his TRUNK only AFTER seeing the Lord coming; he reverently addresses Narayana (SB 8.3.32).
The Lord dismounts and lifts Gajendra ALONG WITH THE CROCODILE out of the lake (SB 8.3.33).
Hari's disc severs the crocodile's mouth; the animal life ends, and Gajendra is rescued (SB 8.3.33).
changes: S01–S06 are editorial subdivisions of four scripture verses. Staged camera travel, wind, light, reaction holds and water motion are original cinematography, not additional scripture episodes.
The screen-locked stylized Gajendra, fierce olive crocodile, four-armed Narayana and golden Garuda must match the user-approved composite without reinterpreting creature anatomy.
The source does not specify exact shore side or a left foreleg. The project keeps those chosen geography details for consistency, with no fabricated wound.
The disc's documented violent outcome is truthfully narrated but depicted by a tasteful bright cutaway, omitting gore, severed flesh and injury closeups.
Huhu's Gandharva restoration and Gajendra's spiritual four-armed sārūpya are not moved into this rescue moment; the following chapters and episodes explain them.
S01: deliberately paced cinematic subdivision with 3 editorial shots, no new scripture events.
S02: deliberately paced cinematic subdivision with 3 editorial shots, no new scripture events.
S03: deliberately paced cinematic subdivision with 3 editorial shots, no new scripture events.
S04 close safe imagery is editorial technique, never a new verse or a claim crocodile survived.
adaptation.fidelity_note: Source-checked 8.3.30–33 with separate screenplay staging. No invented mantra audio, pre-arrival lotus offering, natural crocodile survival, or premature Huhu/Gajendra liberated form. Family-safe render approach keeps the text factually correct.

scenes.title: Heaven hears the sincere prayer
scenes.setting: Gajendra's unchanged Ṛtumat lake after his sincere prayer; distant celestial light is a gentle edited transition, not a newly described divine council.
scenes.action: The prayer is directed to the Supreme Lord; the other devas do not independently respond to that request. Hari hears the appeal and acts, with the actual Garuda-mounted arrival saved for S02.
nonverbal_beats: No fabricated meeting where Brahma, Shiva and Indra decide Gajendra's fate; SB 8.3.30 says they do not approach when the prayer seeks the Supreme.
Hold Gajendra trapped and hopeful, with natural elephant anatomy and chosen left foreleg crocodile grip.
Keep actual Narayana/Garuda visible arrival for S02; S01 visualized with peaceful lake/celestial sky, not a pre-arrival lotus offering.
Any light swelling or heavenly cutaway is original nonverbal staging, not a supernatural event claimed in verse.
Show no new named demigod or invented speaking role.

scenes.action: The Lord arrives with his disc and divine emblems borne on Garuda as praised by heavenly beings, exactly as SB 8.3.31 relates.

scenes.action: Gajendra sees Hari carrying the chakra on Garuda, then with difficulty lifts a lotus in his trunk and respectfully greets Narayana, as SB 8.3.32 explicitly says.

Gajendra's source words to Narayana are represented as a respectful narrator paraphrase only; do not fake an approved elephant-speaking portrait or a recited original mantra.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra's prayer was directed to the Supreme Lord.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడి ప్రార్థన ఏ ఒక్క దేవతకూ కాక, పరమాత్మకే చేరింది.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र की प्रार्थना किसी एक देवता से नहीं, परम भगवान से थी।
text.en: Gajendra's prayer was directed to the Supreme Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: So the other devas did not come separately to free him.

text.te: అందుకే వేరే దేవతలు స్వయంగా వచ్చి అతన్ని విడిపించలేదు.
text.hi: इसीलिए दूसरे देवता स्वयं उसे छुड़ाने नहीं आए।
text.en: So the other devas did not come separately to free him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra sought the Lord who sustains everyone.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు అందరికీ ఆధారమైన పరమాత్మనే ఆశ్రయించాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने सबके आधार परम भगवान की ही शरण ली।
text.en: Gajendra sought the Lord who sustains everyone.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His heartfelt prayer reached Lord Hari.

text.te: అతని భక్తితో నిండిన ప్రార్థన హరికి చేరింది.
text.hi: उसकी भक्ति-भरी प्रार्थना भगवान हरि तक पहुँची।
text.en: His heartfelt prayer reached Lord Hari.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Hari understood Gajendra's suffering.

text.te: హరి గజేంద్రుడు పడుతున్న బాధను తెలుసుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: हरि ने गजेन्द्र की पीड़ा को समझा।
text.en: Hari understood Gajendra's suffering.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord moved swiftly to help him.

text.te: అతనికి సాయం చేయడానికి భగవంతుడు వెంటనే బయలుదేరాడు.
text.hi: उसकी सहायता के लिए भगवान तुरंत चले।
text.en: The Lord moved swiftly to help him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana came riding upon Garuda.

text.te: దివ్యమైన గరుడుడిపై నారాయణుడు వచ్చాడు.
text.hi: भगवान नारायण दिव्य गरुड़ पर सवार होकर आए।
text.en: Narayana came riding upon Garuda.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Garuda carried Him swiftly through the sky.

text.te: గరుడుడు తన బలమైన రెక్కలతో ఆకాశంలో వేగంగా ఎగిరాడు.
text.hi: गरुड़ अपने शक्तिशाली पंखों से आकाश में तेज़ी से उड़े।
text.en: Garuda carried Him swiftly through the sky.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord did not delay after hearing Gajendra's distress.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడి బాధ తెలిసి భగవంతుడు ఆలస్యం చేయలేదు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र की पीड़ा जानकर भगवान ने देर नहीं की।
text.en: The Lord did not delay after hearing Gajendra's distress.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana carried His divine Sudarshana disc.

text.te: నారాయణుడి చేతిలో సుదర్శన చక్రం ఉంది.
text.hi: नारायण के हाथ में सुदर्शन चक्र था।
text.en: Narayana carried His divine Sudarshana disc.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He carried His other divine emblems as well.

text.te: ఇతర దివ్య ఆయుధాలు కూడా ఆయనతో ఉన్నాయి.
text.hi: उनके साथ दूसरे दिव्य आयुध भी थे।
text.en: He carried His other divine emblems as well.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The devas praised Narayana as He approached.

text.te: దేవతలు నారాయణుడిని స్తుతిస్తూ వచ్చారు.
text.hi: देवता नारायण की स्तुति करते हुए साथ आए।
text.en: The devas praised Narayana as He approached.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The lake at Trikuta came into view below.

text.te: దూరంగా త్రికూటంలోని సరస్సు కనిపించింది.
text.hi: दूर त्रिकूट की झील दिखाई दी।
text.en: The lake at Trikuta came into view below.

source_attribution.note: Original wide aerial framing shows the established Trikuta lake approaching in the distance; SB 8.3.31 states Garuda carries Hari to Gajendra, but gives no lens/viewpoint.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra was still caught in the crocodile's grip.

text.te: అక్కడ గజేంద్రుడు ఇంకా మొసలి పట్టులోనే ఉన్నాడు.
text.hi: वहाँ गजेन्द्र अब भी मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में था।
text.en: Gajendra was still caught in the crocodile's grip.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord arrived swiftly where Gajendra suffered.

text.te: భగవంతుడు గజేంద్రుడి దగ్గరకు వేగంగా చేరుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: भगवान तेज़ी से गजेन्द्र के पास पहुँच गए।
text.en: The Lord arrived swiftly where Gajendra suffered.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra saw Narayana approaching on Garuda.

text.te: ఆకాశంలో గరుడుడిపై వస్తున్న నారాయణుడిని గజేంద్రుడు చూశాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने आकाश में गरुड़ पर आते नारायण को देखा।
text.en: Gajendra saw Narayana approaching on Garuda.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He saw the divine disc in the Lord's hand.

text.te: భగవంతుడి చేతిలో సుదర్శన చక్రం కనిపించింది.
text.hi: भगवान के हाथ में सुदर्शन चक्र दिखाई दिया।
text.en: He saw the divine disc in the Lord's hand.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Only then did Gajendra take a lotus in his trunk.

text.te: అప్పుడే గజేంద్రుడు తన తొండంతో ఒక తామర పువ్వును తీసుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: तभी गजेन्द्र ने अपनी सूँड से एक कमल लिया।
text.en: Only then did Gajendra take a lotus in his trunk.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Still held by the crocodile, he struggled to raise it.

text.te: మొసలి పట్టు వల్ల అది ఎత్తడం చాలా కష్టమైంది.
text.hi: मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में रहते उसे उठाना बहुत कठिन था।
text.en: Still held by the crocodile, he struggled to raise it.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Yet he lifted the flower toward the Lord.

text.te: అయినా ఆ పువ్వును భగవంతుడి వైపు పైకెత్తాడు.
text.hi: फिर भी उसने फूल भगवान की ओर ऊपर उठाया।
text.en: Yet he lifted the flower toward the Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra offered Narayana his humble respects.

text.te: నారాయణుడికి గజేంద్రుడు వినయంగా నమస్కరించాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने विनम्रता से नारायण को प्रणाम किया।
text.en: Gajendra offered Narayana his humble respects.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His heart was filled with devotion.

text.te: అతని మనసంతా భక్తితో నిండిపోయింది.
text.hi: उसका मन गहरी भक्ति से भर गया।
text.en: His heart was filled with devotion.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Seeing Gajendra's suffering, Narayana descended from Garuda.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడి బాధను చూసి నారాయణుడు గరుడుడి మీద నుంచి దిగాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र की पीड़ा देखकर नारायण गरुड़ से उतर आए।
text.en: Seeing Gajendra's suffering, Narayana descended from Garuda.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord approached him with great compassion.

text.te: భగవంతుడు ఎంతో కరుణతో గజేంద్రుడి వైపు వచ్చాడు.
text.hi: भगवान बड़ी करुणा से गजेन्द्र के पास आए।
text.en: The Lord approached him with great compassion.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The crocodile still held Gajendra's leg.

text.te: ఆ సమయంలో కూడా మొసలి గజేంద్రుడి కాలును పట్టుకుని ఉంది.
text.hi: उस समय भी मगरमच्छ ने गजेन्द्र का पैर पकड़ा हुआ था।
text.en: The crocodile still held Gajendra's leg.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narayana came close to help Gajendra.

text.te: నారాయణుడు గజేంద్రుడికి సాయం చేయడానికి చేరుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: नारायण गजेन्द्र की सहायता के लिए आगे बढ़े।
text.en: Narayana came close to help Gajendra.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: His compassionate attention stayed on Gajendra's distress.

text.te: ఆయన కరుణకు గజేంద్రుడి కష్టం కనిపించింది.
text.hi: उनकी करुणामयी दृष्टि में गजेन्द्र का कष्ट था।
text.en: His compassionate attention stayed on Gajendra's distress.

source_attribution.note: Original gentle visual attention/eye-line staging of Narayana's scripture-confirmed mercy; 8.3.33 reports His compassion, but not the exact gaze/camera moment.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The Lord raised Gajendra out of the lake.

text.te: భగవంతుడు గజేంద్రుడిని సరస్సు నుంచి పైకి ఎత్తాడు.
text.hi: भगवान ने गजेन्द्र को झील से ऊपर उठाया।
text.en: The Lord raised Gajendra out of the lake.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: He lifted the crocodile along with Gajendra.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడిని పట్టుకున్న మొసలినీ అతనితోపాటే ఎత్తాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र को पकड़े हुए मगरमच्छ को भी साथ उठाया।
text.en: He lifted the crocodile along with Gajendra.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Both emerged from the water while the grip still held.

text.te: ఇద్దరూ నీళ్ల నుంచి బయటకు వచ్చారు. మొసలి పట్టు ఇంకా విడలేదు.
text.hi: दोनों पानी से बाहर आए, लेकिन मगरमच्छ की पकड़ अभी बनी थी।
text.en: Both emerged from the water while the grip still held.
